name: Docxcelerate
tagline: Write Word documents like you write websites.
taglineShort: Documents as components. DOCX as output.
blurb: Docxcelerate turns DOCX generation into component work. You compose documents from small typed JSX components — the same JSX you already write for the web — and preview them in a local browser app as you edit. Hooks let a model write the paragraphs that change per recipient. Finished documents pack into reusable templates you can generate at volume.
description:
Docxcelerate is a TypeScript toolkit for producing DOCX files from code, built on the idea that a document is a component tree rather than a template string with holes punched in it.

You describe a document in JSX. A Document sets the page, the styles and the metadata; Section groups content; inside those live the nodes you write yourself — paragraphs, tables, images, clipart — each one an ordinary typed function component. Data flows in through a useState hook that selects from your own typed payload, so a document expecting a TenancyData object fails to compile when that shape changes rather than silently rendering a blank line. Components compose and re-use exactly the way they do on the web, because they are the same components: the same JSX runtime, the same mental model, the same editor tooling.

Where a document needs to say something different for each recipient, a useSetPrompts hook hands that one paragraph to a model along with the context it needs — so the AI writes a sentence, not the whole letter.

The CLI scaffolds a workspace with npx docxcelerate init, and npm run dev opens a local preview app where documents render as you edit them. Nothing leaves your machine: authoring, preview and DOCX packing all run locally on Node 20 or newer. When a document is ready it packs into a reusable template the generation engine runs at volume, so the thing you previewed is the thing that ships.

The package publishes to both npm and JSR with full type declarations, a nine-out-of-nine JSR documentation score, and every entrypoint documented. MIT licensed.

alternativeTo.name: docx (npm)
alternativeTo.why: Docxcelerate builds on docx for the OOXML layer, and adds the component model, the typed data flow and the live preview on top of it.

alternativeTo.name: docxtemplater
alternativeTo.why: Templating happens in code you can type-check and compose, rather than in placeholder tags inside a .docx a non-developer edits.

alternativeTo.name: Pandoc
alternativeTo.why: Pandoc converts between finished formats. Docxcelerate generates documents per-record from typed data, with layout and styling authored in components.

alternativeTo.name: Carbone
alternativeTo.why: No template server and no service to call — authoring, preview and packing all run locally on Node.

alternativeTo.name: python-docx
alternativeTo.why: The same imperative capability, expressed declaratively in JSX, in a TypeScript codebase that already has the data models.

alternativeTo.name: Aspose.Words
alternativeTo.why: MIT licensed and free, against a per-developer commercial licence.
